마가복음 7:1.content: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

마가복음 7:2.content: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

마가복음 7:3.content: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

마가복음 7:4.content: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

마가복음 7:5.content: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

마가복음 7:6.content: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

마가복음 7:7.content: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

마가복음 7:8.content: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

마가복음 7:9.content: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

마가복음 7:10.content: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

마가복음 7:11.content: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

마가복음 7:12.content: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

마가복음 7:13.content: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

마가복음 7:14.content: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

마가복음 7:15.content: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

마가복음 7:16.content: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

마가복음 7:17.content: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

마가복음 7:18.content: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

마가복음 7:19.content: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

마가복음 7:20.content: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

마가복음 7:21.content: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

마가복음 7:22.content: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

마가복음 7:23.content: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

마가복음 7:24.content: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

마가복음 7:25.content: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

마가복음 7:26.content: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

마가복음 7:27.content: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

마가복음 7:28.content: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.

마가복음 7:29.content: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

마가복음 7:30.content: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

마가복음 7:31.content: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

마가복음 7:32.content: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

마가복음 7:33.content: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

마가복음 7:34.content: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

마가복음 7:35.content: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

마가복음 7:36.content: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

마가복음 7:37.content: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
